# Welcome to Quarto^&ZeroWidthSpace;[®]{.trademark}^

This site is now a compact, editorial-style workspace built around three clear paths: overview, guide, and blog. The homepage acts as the front door, the guide explains how the site fits together, and the blog holds updates, notes, and shorter reflections.

## What you can do here

Explore the site in the order that makes the most sense for you. Start with the overview if you want the broad picture, open the guide if you need structure, or jump into the blog if you want a lighter, more personal stream of updates.

## Why this shape works

By keeping the site small and clearly divided, each page can stay focused. The result is easier navigation, less clutter, and a better place to grow content over time without losing the original structure.
:::
